A further prayer is made for issuance of writ in the nature of mandamus seeking directions to the respondent respondent-PSTCL PSTCL to permit the petitioners holding a degree or diploma diploma in engineering to apply and be considered for recruitment to the said posts. An advertisement bearing no.CRA no.CRA-11/2021 11/2021 dated 18.05.2021 (Annexure P-1) P 1) was issued by respondent respondent-PSTCL for recruitment to 350 posts of Assistant Lineman (ALM) and 150 posts of Assistant Sub Sub-Station Station Attendant (ASSA) The essential eligibility qualifications prescribed therein included a Full Time regular ITI certificate in Electrical/Wireman Trade from a recognised institution. institution. The petitioners attempted to apply to the said posts online but were unsuccessful since the portal did not allow them to enter degree/diploma in Engineering as a qualification without selecting the option for 02-year 02 year ITI certificate.
